notes: Two-tablet mode is now called Dual Mode, and you switch it on from the Library screen's menu instead of from the sidebar while reading - it was too easily confused with Sync Library (Wi-Fi), which is the separate feature that copies music between tablets. Nothing about how the two tablets work together has changed, only where you set it up. On the second tablet, holding the middle of the page for about three seconds now switches Dual Mode off and returns you to the Library, rather than opening a menu. You can also now send a single piece to another tablet straight from that piece's own menu; until now that only existed for playlists, or for several pieces at once after turning on Select pieces. Finally, the backup screen explains its own numbers: it says how many files it is saving and how many pieces those files belong to, because a large library really does hold tens of thousands of files - every piece is a PDF plus a small separate file for each kind of marking on it - and that number looked like a fault with nothing next to it. Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
